title: Create a CRM Event Set
content_data:
Use this endpoint to create a CRM (Customer relationship management) Event Set within an advertiser account. The maximum number of CRM Event Sets allowed within an advertiser account is 50. > **Important**
> By using Events API endpoints, you agree to the [TikTok Business Products (Data) Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/policy/business-products-terms) and that you will not share sensitive data with TikTok. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/crm/create/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | advertiser_id {Required} | string | Advertiser ID. | | name {Required} | string | The name for the CRM Event Set that you want to create within the ad account.

Length limit: 40 characters.
Leading and trailing spaces will be trimmed, and the resulting name must not be empty.

Note: Duplicate CRM Event Set names are not allowed.

| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/crm/create/' \\ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \\ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \\ --data '{ "advertiser_id": "{{advertiser_id}}", "name": "{{name}}" }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| event_set_id | string | The ID of the CRM Event Set. | #| name | string | The name of the CRM Event Set. | #| create_time | string | The time when the CRM Event Set was created, in [ISO-8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) format.

Example: `2026-01-01T00:00:01Z`. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "event_set_id": "{{event_set_id}}", "name": "{{name}}", "create_time": "{{create_time}}" } } (/code) ```
